notes: PleaToken is a fixed-supply ERC-20 named plea (PLEA) with 18 decimals. Its constructor takes no arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 tokens once to msg.sender, the factory at launch. It has no owner, additional minting, transfer fees or privileged controls. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. pool.initialPrice records provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and the total supply.
